notes: Batch 0224 translates comments in six src/backend/commands/ .c files (part 3): collationcmds.c, matview.c, operatorcmds.c, prepare.c, seclabel.c, statscmds.c. 371 of 387 block comments translated, 16 preserved: SQL command-name section banners (CREATE COLLATION, ALTER COLLATION, CREATE STATISTICS, ALTER STATISTICS), one translator: comment, six #endif condition labels, and five identifier-only comments (PlannerInfo x2, varRelid, jointype, SpecialJoinInfo). Copyright and IDENTIFICATION lines stay in English. Operator terminology: commutator/negator → 交换操作符/否定操作符 (matching pg_operator.c and pgnls zh_CN), restriction/join estimator → 限制/连接选择率估计函数 (Selectivity → 选择率). Next suggested: copy.c / copyfrom.c / copyfromparse.c / copyto.c (copy family) or alter.c / cluster.c / variable.c.
